verdict.rationale: Qdrant offers a free-forever 1GB cloud cluster with no credit card required, according to community reports, and its own docs say 'No payment method required.' It is also Apache-2.0 and can be self-hosted for free via Docker or run in-memory for quick proofs of concept. Together these give developers a meaningful way to prototype before paying. Missing for 10: first-party pricing documentation detailing the free-tier limits (storage, RAM, inactivity/suspension policy), and hands-on evidence of prototyping specifically on the hosted free cluster.
